name: Maid to no Amai Seikatsu
source: The protagonist, Katsuragi Nozomi, is being taken care of by his kind maid, Saionji Hinano, while his busy parents are away on a business trip. His carefree aunt, Igarashi Ayano, also visits often, and both women dote on him. One day, Nozomi watches an anime DVD in his parents' bedroom and sees his mother in a shocking scene of intimacy with his father, causing him to ejaculate. After this incident, his relationships with Hinano and Ayano start to change, and Nozomi tries to become a better man with their guidance.
translation: 主角葛城希由善良的女仆西园寺日野照顾，而忙碌的父母却出差在外。他无忧无虑的姨妈五十岚绫野也经常来访，两个女人都很宠爱他。有一天，希美在父母的卧室里观看动画DVD，看到母亲与父亲的亲密场景令人震惊，导致他射精。这次事件之后，他与日野和绫野的关系开始发生变化，希美试图在他们的指导下成为一个更好的人。
